words.gloss: need; avoir besoin de = to need

lines.trans: You looked in a great hurry.
I am picking up Charlotte at the airport.
You must read Oscar's script.
You did not read it last night?
No, the baby cried non-stop.
Charlotte is going to ask me a thousand questions.
When do you want my opinion on the story?
I need you to devour it immediately.

words.gloss: need; avoir besoin de = to need

lines.trans: I must buy a little time.
I will send you a text very quickly.
Hurry up, we are really short on time.
I am starting reading right away.

words.gloss: continuation; tout de suite = right away

meanings.note: avoir l'air + adjective = to look, to seem

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: À mon avis, c'est une bonne idée.
examples.trans: In my opinion, it's a good idea.

meanings.note: un avis de décès = a death notice / obituary
à mon avis = in my opinion

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: elle a besoin d'aide = she needs help

examples.text: Elle a une tête de bébé.

meanings.note: always masculine, even for a girl
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

meanings.en: aller chercher = to go and get, fetch

examples.text: Elles commencent avec un peu de Botox.
examples.trans: They start with a bit of Botox.

meanings.en: commencer par / avec: to start with
faire ses comptes = to do one's accounts

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.en: to hurry, to rush; se dépêcher = to hurry up

examples.text: Il faut se dépêcher, c'est loin.
examples.trans: We must hurry, it is far.

examples.text: Tu m'as dévorée comme une hyène!
examples.trans: You devoured me like a hyena!

meanings.note: raconter une histoire = to tell a story

examples.text: Je dois régler ce problème immédiatement.
examples.trans: I must settle this problem immediately.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Cette lecture vous fera du bien.
examples.trans: This reading will do you good.

meanings.en: to be missed by (tu me manques = I miss you)
meanings.note: back to front: the person missed is the subject
du matin = a.m., in the morning
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all
un peu = a little, a bit

meanings.note: tu viens quand? = when are you coming?

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

meanings.note: poser une question = to ask a question
hors de question = out of the question
marqué en rouge = marked in red

examples.text: Les jours sont marqués en rouge.
examples.trans: The days are marked in red.

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
before the verb; t' before a vowel
tout le temps = all the time
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
